text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Amazing! This sensation! Miles truly are 
where I'm at my best!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
My next goal is the NHK Mile Cup at 1600m? 
Can I really give up on the 2400m Yushun 
Himba (Japanese Oaks)? Europe's greatest 
GI is 2400m, after all...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
—No, let us pass on the 2,400m. My 
ultimate goal is a "European G1 victory." 
What I wish to show the world is not 
recklessness, but courage.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
To maximize possibilities, we'll take on 
the world at the mile! The next target is 
the best match: the NHK Mile Cup!
